name: sc-remote-endpoint-ops-toolkit
description: Query, manage, and troubleshoot ScreenConnect (ConnectWise Control) sessions via the RESTful API Manager extension. Machine lookups, command execution with output capture, read-only diagnostic playbooks (event logs, sound, OneDrive, network, health, memory, drivers, battery), and chat-transcript retrieval. Optional auto-logging of commands/output/chat as private redacted notes on a Freshservice ticket.
